title: Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25k Fresh Mint Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Fresh Mint delivers a clear Mint note with a brisk Menthol finish for a clean, palate-resetting taste. The profile is straightforward and refreshing, ideal on its own or paired with a fruit refill for contrast. Designed for use with the Hayati Ultra 25K Prefilled Pod Kit, this pack pairs a 2ml prefilled pod with two 10ml auto-refilling containers for hassle-free performance and minimal upkeep. The mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt work together to provide smooth MTL vapour, a defined mint profile and fast nicotine satisfaction. Check out our full lineup of Hayati Pro Ultra Plus pods : Find your favourite flavour How to Set Up Hayati Pro Ultra Plus 25K Pods Step 1 Remove all protective seals from the 2ml pod and both 10ml refill containers. Step 2 Click the 2ml pod into the mouthpiece module. Step 3 Align and click up to two 10ml auto-refilling containers into the mouthpiece. Step 4 Insert the assembled unit into the device. Step 5 Allow a short moment for the coil to saturate before vaping. ✅ You're all set!
